cause: The fresh owned Chrome profile has no Settings storage key, while the store initializes theme to system. The native runner first clicked the already-selected System option and expected a persisted key. The installed Radix controlled Select suppresses onValueChange when the selected value equals its current value, so this click does not call setTheme or write storage.
source_evidence: tests/browser/native-sidepanel-qa-harness.mjs creates a new profile with mkdtemp before starting Chrome.
src/state/settings.ts initializes theme to system and persists only through the setTheme setter.
src/features/settings/SettingsView.tsx passes settings.theme as the controlled Select value and calls setTheme in onValueChange.

Installed @radix-ui/react-select 2.3.7 delegates SelectItem selection to useControllableState; its installed controlled-state implementation invokes onChange only when the next value differs from prop.
Run 37109936928 observed System in the guest Settings UI, no recognized stored theme, and no save error or retry.
repair: Choose Light first and assert the actual Chrome storage value, then choose System and assert its storage value before the existing rejection, retry, overlap, reload, and storage assertions.
